title: Visualization Plane
description: Tileset nodes, GLB tile specs, the visual_tiles catalog row, and the per-cell GPU record (ARCHITECTURE.md sections 5.5, 9, 10, 11). NOTE: tileset.json and GLB generation are NOT implemented in this pass — q_tileset::UnimplementedTilesetBuilder and q_gltf::UnimplementedGlbBuilder return NotImplemented (CESIUM-001, GLB-001). This schema fixes the shapes those builders must produce so the daemon, the catalog, and the viewer cannot drift while the builders are written.

bounding_box.description: 3D Tiles `box` form: centre plus three half-axes.

visual_tile_row.description: The `visual_tiles` table of ARCHITECTURE.md section 5.5. Implemented in crates/q-catalog/src/schema.rs.

qtile_uri.description: The .qtile sidecar holding the actual values. Required whenever glb_uri is set: a GLB may never be the only carrier of tensor data (ARCHITECTURE.md section 10.1).

tileset_node.description: One node of the hierarchy q_tileset::TilesetNode emits. Geometric error MUST strictly decrease with depth or the child never refines and its subtree is unreachable — validated by TilesetNode::validate_refinement.

glb_tile_spec.description: What a GLB tile may contain (ARCHITECTURE.md section 10.2). It may NOT contain full FP16/BF16 weights, many copies of the same cube mesh, reproducible analysis results, or exact tensor data for the whole model. Implemented as q_gltf::GlbTileSpec.

instance_count.description: Instance transforms over ONE shared mesh. Capped at 262144: one cube per weight is a data explosion, not a visualization optimization (ARCHITECTURE.md section 19).

request_gpu_instancing.description: Request EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing. A request, not an assumption: ARCHITECTURE.md section 10.2 requires checking the renderer's real support level and keeping a fallback.

visual_cell.description: The minimal per-cell GPU record of ARCHITECTURE.md section 11.1. Absolute positions are NOT stored: the shader computes position = tile_origin + decode_morton(morton_coordinate) * cell_spacing. Storing positions per scalar is forbidden by section 19.
